summary: SC Forestry Commission (Sand Hills State Forest) Sugarloaf Mountain site SL 2: confirmed $15/night (now manual, 2026) and phone-only reservations, required, to the forest office during office hours (never first-come); one shelter site on Mountain Road near Mountain Pond with a restroom nearby, generators allowed. No closure or alert on the forest page. Note trimmed of the price and booking facts. Not stated: season, hookups, site length, road surface, restroom type.
flags: RV access not stated: scfc.gov gives no site length, road description or vehicle limit for SL 2 (on Mountain Road in the Sugarloaf Mountain Recreation Area, off Hartsville Ruby Road/SC 109 west of Patrick); the page calls all 20 forest campsites 'primitive'. No 4WD/high-clearance statement either way. Nothing contrary found; the 23-ft fit rests on AWH's note and the site photos.
